title: Monthly duration report for Bayview (request from Rachel Stein)
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Request from Rachel Stein, CIO of Bayview Teachers Pension Fund, after the kickoff meeting.

She wants a monthly report with:
- Portfolio duration (now 6.4 years) and convexity (0.82)
- Duration by maturity bucket
- +/-100 basis points stress results
- Progress on the Q4 rebalance

Due: first report in November. Template draft by Oct 14.
Assignee on our side: Sruly. Joe Smith approves before sending; Maria Delgado reviews the methodology notes.
